title: CYP Induction, Part 2/3
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters in the fields provided above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: Upload your custom labware files (.json extensions) to the OT App.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware.
Select the .json labware files and confirm.

steps.title: Upload .py protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol file with a .py extension to the OT App’s Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tiprack, and pipette using the OT App (refer to support articles for tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to start the protocol.
